request.style: English, female solo voice with soft backing choir, Celtic harp, tin whistle, bodhran, uilleann pipes, warm and solemn, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Never let your zeal grow slack
Be fervent in spirit today
Serve the Lord with steady hand
In the light of His grace

[Verse]
Share with the saints in their need
Pursue hospitality for all
Live in harmony with one another
Do not be arrogant at all

[Chorus]
Bless those who persecute you
Bless them and do not curse
Rejoice with those who rejoice
Weep with those who weep

[Verse]
Repay no one evil for evil
Give thought to what is honorable
If it is possible for you
Live at peace with everyone

[Chorus]
Bless those who persecute you
Bless them and do not curse
Rejoice with those who rejoice
Weep with those who weep

[Bridge]
Associate with the lowly ones
Do not be wise in your own eyes
Endure in affliction always
Persevere in prayer

[Outro]
Live at peace with everyone
Bless them and do not curse
